item.title: UP officers invoke Bhagat Singh, Buddha to explain duty, justice and use of force
item.summary: During the Independence Day celebrations in Uttar Pradesh, two officers reflected on public service and the importance of accountability. One officer referenced Bhagat Singh to address the frustrations surrounding the justice system's inefficiencies. The other drew from a Gautama Buddha story to discuss the responsible use of police authority, emphasizing that with greater power comes a duty to prioritize service over personal interests and mere salary considerations.
